method.reason: HCN is a small 3-atom closed-shell molecule, so a hybrid DFT method is affordable. PBE0 is one of the user-allowed choices and provides a balanced description for GIAO NMR shielding without the cost of a larger method; RHF would be cheaper but less suitable for correlated shielding response.

basis.reason: The user allows def2-SVP or def2-TZVP. For a 3-atom molecule the larger def2-TZVP triple-zeta basis is still low-cost and is preferable for magnetic shielding tensor and isotropic values, reducing basis-set sensitivity. No additional reference/experimental calibration is required.

proposal.reason: Select the user-authorized method and basis before any scientific ORCA execution. PBE0/def2-TZVP is practical for the tiny HCN system and appropriate for requested GIAO shieldings; geometry preparation can then be followed by the fixed-geometry shielding calculation.
